# Rollbar

> Rollbar is a real-time error tracking and debugging platform that helps software teams identify, understand, and fix production errors with AI-powered automation and session replay.

Rollbar provides comprehensive error monitoring, session replay, and automated error fixing capabilities across multiple programming languages and frameworks. The platform integrates with popular development tools and CI/CD workflows to streamline error resolution and deployment tracking.

## Key Topics

- Error Monitoring & Tracking
- Session Replay
- AI-Powered Error Fixing
- Real-time Alerts & Notifications
- Deploy Tracking
- RQL (Rollbar Query Language)
- Multi-language SDK Support
- CI/CD Integration
- Telemetry & Breadcrumbs
- REST API
- Slack & Email Notifications
- JavaScript, Python, Go, Java, .NET
- Production Error Management
- Anomaly Detection
- Automated PR Generation

## Core Platform Features

- [Rollbar Platform](https://rollbar.com/platform): Rollbar platform overview: error monitoring, session replay, RQL, alerts
- [Rollbar Resolve](https://rollbar.com/resolve-alpha): AI-powered automated error fixing with PR generation for production errors
- [Session Replay](https://rollbar.com/session-replay): Session Replay feature for error monitoring and debugging across platforms
